The relay server is part of ParleyPort's kit module, next to the client side of the protocol. Every client connects exactly as before.

## ✨ Added

- **The relay takes a new kind of member, the viewer**, such as a tile that only reads. A viewer proves its identity like a phone or a browser extension does, so no other connection can take its place.

## ⚡ Improved

- **One copy of the relay protocol.** The server runs the relay from the kit the apps connect with, so a change to the protocol, both of its ends and the shared test vectors land together. The log still says why a connection ended.
